get.summary: Lists customers page by page, optionally filtered by a search text.

post.summary: Registers a new customer.

put.summary: Replaces a customer's name and contact details.

delete.summary: Deletes a customer who owns no vehicles and has no work orders.

get.summary: Lists the vehicles a customer owns, oldest registration first.

post.summary: Registers a vehicle for a customer.

put.summary: Records an odometer reading; readings never go backwards.

post.summary: Transfers a vehicle to another existing customer.

get.summary: Lists a vehicle's work orders page by page, newest first, across all owners.

post.summary: Opens a draft work order for the vehicle's current owner at intake.

get.summary: Gets a work order with its lines and totals.

post.summary: Adds labour (hours × hourly rate) to an editable work order.
Adds a part (quantity × unit price) to an editable work order.

delete.summary: Removes a line from an editable work order; the other lines keep their numbers.

post.summary: The customer agrees to the estimate of a draft; its total becomes the approved total.
A mechanic starts work on an approved work order.
Marks the work as done; from then on the lines are final.
Cancels a draft or approved work order, with a reason.

get.summary: Lists every bay, in and out of service, by name.

post.summary: Adds a bay, in service, with a name no other bay has.

put.summary: Renames a bay; the name must not be in use by another bay.

post.summary: Stops new bookings for a bay; appointments already booked stay until moved.
Puts a bay back in service so it can be booked again.
Books a bay and slot for the vehicle, for its current owner.

get.summary: Gets an appointment, in any status.

post.summary: Moves a scheduled appointment to another slot, another bay, or both.
The vehicle has arrived: opens a draft work order for it and checks the appointment in.
Calls off a scheduled appointment, with a reason; its slot is free again at once.
Records that the vehicle did not arrive, once the slot has begun.

get.summary: One day's appointments per bay; the day is read in the given IANA time zone (default UTC).

post.summary: Issues the invoice for a completed work order with the next number of the year.

get.summary: Gets the invoice issued for a work order.
Lists invoices page by page, newest number first, optionally by status and customer.
Gets an invoice with its lines, totals and payments.
Downloads the invoice as a PDF, with the payments received so far.

post.summary: Records money received; part payments are fine, more than the balance is not.
Signs in with e-mail address and password and returns a bearer token.
Changes the signed-in user's password; the current password is required.

get.summary: Lists every staff account, active or not, by display name.

post.summary: Opens a staff account with a role and an initial password.

put.summary: Gives an account another role; the last active owner keeps theirs.

post.summary: Stops an account from signing in; its tokens stop working at once.
Lets a deactivated account sign in again.
